# Mockifyer — full reference for AI assistants

> Mockifyer records and replays HTTP requests made via axios or fetch. Mock data is stored as JSON files under `mock-data/<scenario>/`. Official site: https://mockifyer.dev

## Packages (install these, not the repo root)

| Package | Version | Purpose |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-core` | 1.10.190 | Mocks, scenarios, client lanes, date control, activation modes, providers |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-axios` | 1.10.35 | Axios integration for Node and backend services |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-fetch` | 1.8.106 | fetch, React Native, Metro sync, Atlas tracing (t key in Metro) |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-dashboard` | 1.5.93 | Web UI, Redis/SQLite, Network view, scenario/lane management, Date Config |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-mcp` | 0.1.5 | 42 MCP tools for Cursor/Claude (search, AI context, field overrides, explain_value) (not on npm — build from `packages/mockifyer-mcp`) |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-test-helper` | 1.8.9 | Test utilities and auto-setup for realistic mock data in tests (not on npm — build from `packages/mockifyer-test-helper`) |

## Setup (axios)

Initialize **before** importing axios:

```typescript
import { setupMockifyer } from '@sgedda/mockifyer-axios';

setupMockifyer({
  mockDataPath: './mock-data',
  recordMode: process.env.MOCKIFYER_RECORD === 'true',
  useGlobalAxios: true,
});

import axios from 'axios';
```

## Activation modes (Node axios/fetch)

| Mode | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| `always` | Default — all requests use Mockifyer |
| `client_id_header` | Only when `X-Mockifyer-Client-Id` is set |
| `off` | Plain HTTP |

Env: `MOCKIFYER_ACTIVATION_MODE` overrides config.

## React Native startup

`MOCKIFYER_MODE`: `on` (default) | `launch_client` | `manual` | `off` — gates fetch patching at startup via `setupMockifyerForReactNative`. `manual` (aliases: `e2e`, `maestro`, `gui`, `toggle`) enables programmatic control.

## Common environment variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `MOCKIFYER_RECORD` | Record real responses |
| `MOCKIFYER_PATH` | Mock data root |
| `MOCKIFYER_SCENARIO` | Active scenario |
| `MOCKIFYER_CLIENT_ID` | Client lane (multi-service / Redis proxy) |
| `MOCKIFYER_ACTIVATION_MODE` | always \| client_id_header \| off |
| `MOCKIFYER_RECORD_NEW_AS_PASSTHROUGH` | New mocks stay on live API until dashboard activation |
| `MOCKIFYER_USE_SIMILAR_MATCH` | Path fallback matching |
| `MOCKIFYER_DATE` / `OFFSET` / `TIMEZONE` | Date manipulation |

## GraphQL

Request keys: normalized query + sorted variables JSON.

## Dashboard & MCP

```bash
npx @sgedda/mockifyer-dashboard --path ./mock-data
```

MCP server (42 tools) includes: `mockifyer_get_mock_ai_context`, `mockifyer_search_mocks`, `mockifyer_set_field_overrides`, `mockifyer_list_scenarios`, `mockifyer_explain_value`, `mockifyer_explain_incident`, `mockifyer_set_mock_behavior` (status/delay overrides), override group tools, Atlas tools, fixture pool tools, and `mockifyer_promote_response`. Build from `packages/mockifyer-mcp` (not on npm).

Dashboard mock API also exposes `/api/mocks/:file/ai-context` for lightweight field/schema projections.

## Request correlation

Outbound headers: `x-mockifyer-request-id`, `x-mockifyer-parent-request-id` for multi-hop tracing.

## Content Pages

### Guides
- [Mock at the Network Edge](https://mockifyer.dev/guides/mock-at-the-network-edge): Stop mocking hooks and components. Test what users see by mocking HTTP at the network edge.
- [Reproduce Tester Bugs Locally](https://mockifyer.dev/guides/reproduce-tester-bugs): Capture API calls from tester devices and replay bugs locally with full tracing.
- [Stable React Native E2E Tests](https://mockifyer.dev/guides/stable-react-native-e2e): Lock scenarios with launch arguments, freeze dates, and make Detox, Appium, and Maestro tests deterministic.
- [Stop Mock Drift](https://mockifyer.dev/guides/mock-drift): Record real responses, re-record when APIs change, and git diff to catch breaking changes.
- [React Native: Handlers vs Recording](https://mockifyer.dev/guides/react-native-without-msw): Compare MSW and Mockifyer for React Native. Recording works on device with no service worker.
